subject: act
title: ACT.------INFO.TRNS.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-21 — the section closing with Braxton's call: 'There is now a need to combat the mis-information surrounding world information — and we can no longer wait for western scholars and definers to discover universality and bail us out of this dilemma — because these people are part of the problem. The time to act is now (and it was "now" two thousand years ago).' The crossing diagrams how activism structurally meets information-transference at the universal-information scale: ACT (activism) is crossed with INFO-TRNS (information transference). ACT sits centrally with the subject-arrow; JR-DY (journalism dynamics) rises above, with MT-INFO (multi-information) at upper-left and RT-DY (reality dynamics) at top, and INFO-TRNS at upper-right. DOC (documentation) anchors the right margin. CUL-AF-B (culture affinity basis) sits at right of ACT, below the DOC line, with POL-P (political policies) at lower-right. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) at the left, with DEC (decentralization) at lower-left and C-INFO (composite information) below. POL-DY (political dynamics) hangs at the bottom-center from the main line. Structural argument: when activism is crossed with information-transference, RT-DY rises from the main line, with MT-INFO branching from the RT-DY line and JR-DY from the MT-INFO line. DOC branches from the main line, with CUL-AF-B hanging from the DOC line. POL-DY drops from the main line; POL-P and C-INFO branch from the POL-DY line, C-FO-ACT from the C-INFO line, and DEC from the C-FO-ACT line.
